gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the abstract's universal claim that all listed criteria are NP-hard and admit no PTAS as false because Frobenius-norm minimization is polynomial-time solvable and no-PTAS results are absent for several listed criteria. It also identifies the resulting overstatement and proposes restricting the abstract claim to the established subset, matching the gold defect and repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries identify the same invalid universal abstract-level scope claim: the paper does not establish NP-hardness and PTAS-inapproximability for every listed criterion, including a listed criterion with an exact polynomial-time algorithm.
